key_insight: A closed-loop optimizer calibrates atomistic GaAs growth kinetics directly from experimental growth data, reducing reliance on costly DFT-derived rate parameters.
engineering_relevance: The framework could support MOCVD process optimization by turning routine growth measurements into a mechanistically interpretable deposition model.
method: Simulate atomistic deposition events with kinetic Monte Carlo (KMC).
Use Monte Carlo Tree Search to calibrate kinetic rate parameters against experimental growth data.
Guide parameter searches using each reaction’s degree of rate control.
evidence_signal: For GaAs MOCVD, the calibrated model captures the measured growth-rate dependence on temperature and recovers three known kinetic regimes with changing rate-determining steps.
watch_item: Transfer to other deposition processes requires a suitable rate-controlled event model; the abstract reports validation only for GaAs.
paper_title: Atomistic Insights into MOCVD Growth of GaAs using a Closed Loop Autonomous System Combining Directed Reinforcement Learning and Kinetic Monte Carlo Simulations
